description: The pie chart visually breaks down the time cost distribution into two components: “Reduction,” which accounts for 60.9 seconds (69.92%) and is represented by a large orange segment, and “Efficient deployment,” which accounts for 26.2 seconds (30.08%) and is shown as a smaller blue segment that is slightly exploded outward for emphasis. The chart illustrates that the majority of the time cost is attributed to the reduction phase, while efficient deployment constitutes a smaller but significant portion. Although the caption references a total time of 92.5s and a 72.5% reduction, the chart itself depicts a post-optimization breakdown totaling 87.1s (60.9s + 26.2s), suggesting the chart may represent time allocation after optimization rather than a direct comparison of before-and-after totals. The visual emphasizes the relative contribution of each phase to the overall time expenditure.
caption_used: Efficient deployment methods significantly reduce the time cost, with the average total time cost before efficient deployment being 92.5s (30.5s + 62s). This represents a reduction of approximately 72.5% after efficient deployment, highlighting the substantial impact of optimization strategies.
